controlled_estimator: dS + (S-b)*dlogq; b is independent pilot mean risk, frozen before main and not differentiated
independence_interpretation: separate domain-separated PRNG streams implementing the independent-sampling model; not an empirical or cryptographic independence certification
comparison_limit: same total paths per arm, not equal runtime; two arms double E25 one-arm total study work; no total-study equality claim
fixed_uniform_comparison_criterion: each paired case: controlled negative MAE and max absolute error strictly lower than raw, nonpositive negative-gradient count <= raw, and both arms pass risk/positive analytic checks
failure_policy: retain every row, never change samples/coefficient/seed/threshold after result; no retries
resource_policy: single local diagnostic process, O(N+K) estimator working memory, no models or retained trajectories; no peak-memory measurement claim
